result.summary: Found 3 major layout issues where content is being cut off at the screen edges, affecting visibility and usability of restaurant cards and filter options.

issues.description: Third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol' is partially cut off on the right edge in the 'Fastest near you' section, obscuring the full name and limiting visibility
issues.suggestion: Ensure all restaurant cards fit properly within the viewport or implement clearer horizontal scroll indicators to show there is more content available

issues.description: Category filter pill on the far right (after 'Healthy') is partially hidden/faded, suggesting content overflow without clear scrolling indication
issues.suggestion: Either hide the cut-off category pill entirely or implement visible horizontal scrolling with proper indicators (arrows or scroll hints)

issues.description: Popular restaurant card at the bottom (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off at the right edge, partially obscuring the restaurant details
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width and margins to ensure all content fits within the viewport boundaries, or implement proper responsive design for different screen sizes
